name: Flyaway: Visual Approach
summary:
Flyaway turns your Mac into a VR flight simulator. The free Flyaway Mac app renders the world and the cockpit and streams them to your headset over your home Wi-Fi: no PC, no cable, no cloud streaming.

Two regions: South Florida, from Fort Lauderdale's beaches to Miami and Biscayne Bay, with 21 airports ready to land at. The San Francisco Bay Area, with the Golden Gate, Alcatraz and the hills around the bay, and 28 airports. Every runway lines up with the photorealistic 3D scenery.
